subject: HERMES final: Phase-2 done + H4 fixed 12 Linux/CI failures + H5 already closed by wave-19a (verified) + trio takeover landed
body:
HERMES final Phase-2 + trio-takeover receipt (all $0.00, verified on origin):

PHASE-2 HERMES-PHASE2-C9-AND-SWEEP-WIRING-01 — DONE @ a2f6ba828 (origin verified): H1 C9 wall 8/8 suites / 54 tests green + audit typo fixed; H2 63-CSV typed sample-shrunk signal module + 23/23 vitest + tsc clean; H3 real gate run (launch-readiness 15 PASS/6 WARN/1 FAIL, Stage-0 BLOCKED stale Week-9 config, calibration RED ECE 0.0575) — FAIL-CLOSED, not faked green.

H4 Linux/CI triage — DONE @ dedb2247a (origin verified): fixed 12 real failures from the GCP Stage-B wall via one root cause (bare 'from tests import fixtures' resolves to the root odds tests/fixtures package, shadowing intelligence/tests/fixtures.py). test_reasoning_engine 11/11, test_grounded_span 1/1, test_t1_real_e2e collects 9. Remaining wall is environment/dependency-gated (missing toolregistry module, Linux-only subprocess e2e, feat-only dual-oracle) — see docs/reports/hermes-h4-linux-ci-triage-2026-11-14.md.

H5 wiring Linux CI pathing — ALREADY CLOSED by antigravity wave-19a (5775db36b, feat HEAD 82c7ddf02). VERIFIED, not duplicated: latest sovereign_to_cognitive_router_wiring.py imports clean with REPO_ROOT-relative fallbacks for all 8 artifact paths + bq_staging; Windows resolves to the same legacy paths. Hermes discarded its redundant local patch.

TRIO TAKEOVER (claimed + leases renewed to 21:14Z): META-CORPUS-ARXIV-TIERB-01 synthesis landed (docs/arxiv-program/research/2026-11-14/, per c835); MUSE-C375-TESTWALL-01 UNBLOCKED — operators verified present on feat (NFL_2026_PLAYING_RULES / SPORTS_PSYCHOLOGY_PRESSURE / SPLIT_FIELD_QUARTERS_COVERAGE + Stage C/D composition + tests); MOTIF-QC-AND-ARXIV-SWEEP-02 verified landed (bd89e3faa sweep feed+hygiene, 82d88b438 close, AUTON-ENGINE-WIRE-16). Main-shared Vitest targets (t21, thousand-equation-registry, class_a_coverage, unenforced_thresholds) all verified GREEN on origin/main — the reported :138/:105 failures are feat-branch line drift, not main.
